question: John is the father of Mary and Joseph is the son of Myra. Ishu is the brother of John. Joseph is the only brother of Mary. How is Myra related to Ishu?
solution:
The table showing the symbols of the relationship is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9e514fcf4d7d1a8f4749234425a42076c427a199789b39e712a20549c56f54d.png] 

John is the father of Mary and Joseph is the son of Myra. Ishu is the brother of John. Joseph is the only brother of Mary.

From the given information following family chart is formed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3a60aaa9b1556014e219c61f514518accae9580b23244f24b2e1e70ef6007d6.png] 

It is clear that John and Myra are a couple having Mary and Joseph as kids. Ishu is brother of John, so** Myra would be his sister-in-law**.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2)**
